error[ZBX-E0535]: the ECR registry did not accept its authorization token
  cause  123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com answered 401 to the
         authorization token AWS had just given
  host   123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  fix    check that the registry's region is the one the token was asked for
         run the command again: the token lasts twelve hours
  more   zbx explain E0535
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0535.html
